name: chaos-dr-test
description: Use when working with Chaos Engineering steps inside a Harness pipeline. Covers ChaosFault, ChaosProbe, ChaosAction steps (DRTest stages), the Chaos step (DRTest stages), and DRTest stage/pipeline structure. Use when the user asks to add, modify, or create chaos steps, fault injection, probes, or disaster recovery test pipelines. Do not use for standalone Chaos Experiment create or edit; use chaos-experiment for those. Trigger phrases: DR test, DRTest pipeline, disaster recovery test, chaos step, ChaosFault step, ChaosProbe step, ChaosAction step.
